senses.def: the faint light after the sun has set; (attributive) the dim zone of the ocean between sunlight and total darkness 暮色；暮光带
examples: the twilight zone of the ocean

senses.def: an area or region with a particular characteristic 地带；区域
a very deep hole or space; the deepest part of the sea 深渊；深海
the total mass of living material in a given area 生物量
the movement of animals to a different region, usually with the seasons 迁徙
able to operate independently, without human control 自主的；独立运作的
a journey made for a particular purpose, especially scientific research 考察；远征
examples: a research expedition to the Arctic

senses.def: a small part of something 小部分；片段
examples: only a fraction of the total

senses.def: to control something so that it stays at a steady level 调节；控制
dark in colour; dim 暗淡的；昏暗的
a long narrow passage; a route that connects two places 走廊；通道
extremely interesting 极其有趣的；迷人的
mostly; mainly 主要地；大部分
to move slowly without a fixed direction 漂流；漂移
examples: The boat drifted out to sea.

senses.def: a group of animals or plants of the same kind 物种
far away from places where people live 偏远的
not closely connected 关系疏远的
to watch something carefully 观察
to form an idea of the amount or value of something 估计
examples: Experts estimate that the work will take a year.

senses.def: to spread over an area or distance 延伸
the usual weather conditions of a region 气候
